events.name: Kyle Kinane
events.pleaseNote: Doors open 30 minutes before show time. This show is 18 & over with valid, government-issued photo ID. There is a two beverage minimum per person. Cameras and video/audio recording devices are permitted but must be checked in at our complimentary coat check upon arrival. $.25 per each ticket sold for most of our shows benefits Comedy Gives Back, a safety net for the comedy community. For more information, please visit www.comedygivesback.com Our events often run for multiple dates/times. Before purchasing, please ensure that you can attend the specific event, date, and time that is listed on the event page. There are no refunds/exchanges unless an event is cancelled/postponed.

accessibility.info: The venue can accommodate patrons with varying needs (wheelchair accessible, limited mobility, visually-impaired, hearing-impaired, etc.).  Please select Wheelchair Accessible for the type of accessible ticket below, regardless of your specific need, and include any companions (up to three) in the ticket quantity.  Seats for additional companions will need to be purchased from standard inventory.  Every effort will be made to sit your entire party together.

ticketLimit.info: There is a 6 ticket limit per household.

venues.name: Cobb's Comedy Club

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Our box office is open on all show days starting one (1) hour prior to the scheduled door time, To purchase tickets online, please visit www.cobbscomedy.com. If you are looking to obtain a refund for a show that was either cancelled or rescheduled, visit www.livenation.com/refund for more information. We look forward to seeing you at one of our upcoming shows!
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call is located at the box office. You can pick up tickets day of show once the box office is open.

venues.parkingDetail: We do not have a parking lot at the club, but street parking is available and there are some garages in the area. To ensure that your night goes smoothly, please allow an extra 20 minutes to find parking.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating tickets are available for purchase via all Ticketmaster sales channels and the venue box office. For additional information call the venue at 415.928.4320.

generalInfo.generalRule: There is a two beverage minimum per person. Age requirement is 18 and over, valid photo ID required for entrance. We do make exceptions for specific family-friendly performances. Please check individual show listings for age requirements or reach out to the box office. Dress Attire is casual. You can access your tickets through the Ticketmaster or Live Nation app. If you do not have the app you will need to download your tickets to your mobile wallet. Will-call can be picked up day of the show once the box office opens with a valid photo ID. All tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable. All seating is General Admission - first come, first served within the respective sections. Camera Policy: Phone cameras are permitted. All other cameras, video cameras, and audio recording devices are not allowed into the venue and will have to be checked in at our complimentary coat check. All bags will be searched upon entry, and no large bags or backpacks will be allowed into the showroom and will have to be checked in at our complimentary coat check. No outside food or drink is allowed. No guns, knives, weapons, pepper spray, projectiles of any kind, or any other item that could be used to inflict harm will be allowed inside.
generalInfo.childRule: Cobb's is an 18 and over venue. Valid ID is required for admission.
